## Dive into new topics with immersive explorations in the Gemini app.
Oct 28, 2026
The Gemini app now has a library of immersive explorations, giving you an interactive, visual way to explore topics layer-by-layer, from microscopic systems to deep space and more. You can access this library in the Gemini student hub by clicking on “Try immersive explorations” and will soon be able to access these immersive explorations directly in a chat conversation with Gemini.
Whether it’s tracing trade routes on the Silk Road, peering inside a jet engine, or studying the physics of lightning, each scene unfolds into interactive and guided experiences. Tap a label to dig deeper, journeying from sweeping planetary scales straight down to molecules and atoms. Immersive explorations will soon include audio narration to walk you through each layer.
This feature is available to all users in English, Indonesian, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, French, and simplified Chinese. Users in all other languages currently receive an English-only experience, with more languages coming soon.
Explore the feature today.
